hook: Your phone would struggle in Oymyakon, Siberia.
title: The Coldest Town on Earth Where People Live
description:
Oymyakon in Siberia is the coldest permanently inhabited place on Earth. A temperature of -67.7 °C was recorded there in 1933. Batteries lose power in the cold, so your phone would struggle.

#Shorts #Siberia #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Could you survive there? Yes or no
